title: State and capture coverage
responsibility: Narrows scenarios to relevant states and judges whether each required recorded capture supports its bound revision.

inputs.name: captureUnbound.capture
inputs.description: Capture whose recorded server revision, kind and provenance determine whether it is tied to the requested commit.

inputs.name: captureUnbound.commit
inputs.description: Commit the capture is expected to support. If a different server revision is recorded, both revisions are shortened in the returned reason.

inputs.name: explorerState.judged
inputs.description: The declared scenario, its recorded result, the record and the commit binding used to judge captures. Null means no result is available to judge.

inputs.name: explorerState.declared
inputs.description: One scenario state with its id and declared coverage. Inapplicable states remain exempt; a declaration whose coverage is not required is treated as incomplete.

inputs.name: explorerState.absent
inputs.description: Fallback standing and reason tuple for a required state with no judged result or recorded state. The standing is used, but the supplied reason text is discarded.

inputs.name: reasonText.text
inputs.description: Reason text to simplify for display. A matching “ in <path>” phrase is removed, and other matching file paths are replaced with “a file”.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.declared
inputs.description: Full declared scenario whose states are filtered for one unit. The returned object keeps its other scenario fields and replaces only the states array.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose applicable scenario states are selected. Visual kinds match states that name the unit or name no units; other kinds use direct or active transitive consumer matches.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.units
inputs.description: Registry units used to resolve the unit kind and follow active consumers through dependency links. Defaults to an empty array; if no state matches the unit or a consumer, the full declared scenario is returned.

inputs.name: coverageWorst.standings
inputs.description: Coverage standings to rank from worst to best. If no value in the fixed order is present, including for an empty array, the result is inapplicable.

outputs.name: reasonText
outputs.description: Returns text with matching “ in <path>” phrases removed and other matching file paths replaced by “a file”. Text outside those matches is unchanged.

outputs.name: scenarioFor
outputs.description: Returns a shallow copy of the scenario with applicable states: visual kinds keep states naming the unit or no units, while other kinds prefer direct matches and then states naming active transitive consumers. If neither matches, all declared states remain.

outputs.name: coverageWorst
outputs.description: Returns the first present standing in failed, stale, missing, incomplete, passed order. Returns inapplicable when none of those values is present.

outputs.name: captureUnbound
outputs.description: Returns a reason when the recorded server revision differs from the requested commit, or when a screenshot or actual-capture provenance has no recorded revision. Returns null for a matching revision or an unstamped other capture kind.
examples: names no build, so it is bound to no commit

outputs.name: explorerState
outputs.description: Returns the state declaration, standing, reasons and capture slots examined. Inapplicable declarations stay exempt; required states need a result recorded as required, at least one declared slot, and a passed, stored, commit-bound capture in every slot.

reasons: Dashboard loads: ready has no result in the record.
